title: Fill & Stroke
description: Set the paint before you draw, and repaint a selection afterwards: stroke, fill, gradients and dashes.

bubble.title: Paint first, or repaint later
bubble.body: The Stroke and Fill sections hold the current paint. Shapes you draw take it; shapes you select get repainted by it.

bubble.title: The Stroke section
bubble.body: Stroke on/off, colour and width live here, with dash pattern, cap and join below. Turn the stroke off and a shape keeps only its fill.

bubble.title: The Fill section
bubble.body: Fill can be a solid colour, a linear gradient or a radial gradient. The preview box shows the exact paint the next shape will get.

bubble.title: Draw with the paint
bubble.body: Press I twice to draw a rectangle with the current stroke and fill.

bubble.title: Repaint the selection
bubble.body: The rectangle is deposited and selected while drawing ends. Change the fill colour now and watch the selected shape — not the next one — change.

bubble.title: Try a gradient
bubble.body: Set the fill type to Linear, pick the two colours, and set the angle. Gradients are part of the shape and export with it.
